name: OCRBench_V2
description: OCRBench v2: Enhanced large-scale bilingual benchmark for evaluating Large Multimodal Models on visual text localization and reasoning with 10,000 human-verified question-answering pairs across 8 core OCR capabilities
typical_sota_score: ~70–85% (top multimodal models as of 2025; Chinese OCR tasks are harder)
reputation: Major OCR benchmark for multimodal LLMs; covers both English and Chinese; expanded from OCRBench v1 with 10K human-verified pairs across diverse document types
notes: Expanded version of OCRBench. Covers 8 OCR capabilities: text recognition, scene text, document understanding, table understanding, chart understanding, math expression recognition, handwriting recognition, and visual text reasoning. Bilingual (English and Chinese) with 10,000 human-verified QA pairs.
